conversion: Original config, N, k, per-prompt fractions, saved random baseline and per-epoch summaries exported losslessly from three historical PKLs. Cached means and enrichment ratios are computed from the fractions, not copied from the saved aggregate.
representation: Final block hook_resid_post at the last token; full training split for modular addition.

baseline.rule: Draw a query uniformly, then k distinct indices from all N prompts; the query itself is eligible. Average the same-answer fractions.
baseline.protocol_replay: A separate deterministic replay on 5 November 2026 matched 0.0088. It is not a recovery of the original random draws.

limitations: Original neighbor-index arrays and random draws were not stored in these PKLs.
The complete-training-set kNN audit is distinct from the N=200 graph used for standard GCS.
